Students will develop thier ability to think from view/stand point of building construction.
個別の教育目標
Students are expected to apply the knowledge acquired in this course to their own doctoral thesis research.

3. To find problems for building construction.
4. To attempt to generate a method for improving.
5. To review the activities in the course.
